title: SSCBench: Evaluating the Evidential Validity of Fault-Injection Tests for Tool-Using LLM Agents
title_zh: <SSCBench：评估工具使用型 LLM 智能体故障注入测试的证据有效性

paragraphs.en: Fault injection is increasingly used to evaluate the reliability of tool-using LLM agents. However, there has been limited study of how fault-adoption results should be interpreted when the agent itself determines which authoritative observations become visible during execution. In this paper, we present a systematic study of this evidential validity problem in agent fault-injection evaluation. We develop a measurement protocol that specifies what observations can refute an injected assertion, determines whether they can become visible before the affected fact is first used, and records whether the evaluated execution actually realizes this condition. We construct SSCBench as an instantiation of the protocol and evaluate four fault operators and five agent configurations over 1,191 faulted executions in two τ \tau -bench environments. Our experiments show that an admitted fault case and agent configuration can realize substantially different evidential conditions across executions, and that aggregate adoption can remain well defined even when the population supporting a timely-counterevidence claim is sparse or absent. For example, among 44 adopted runs in which counterevidence eventually became visible, only 17 received it before first use, while 27 received it afterward. We also find that first-error timing and later stance revision need not coincide, and that automated trajectory analysis can recover adoption without reliably recovering the first faulty-reliance event needed for temporal diagnosis. We argue that the evidential condition realized by an execution and the population supporting a claim-specific interpretation are part of fault-injection evaluation itself and should be reported before adoption is interpreted as failure under pre-use counterevidence.

paragraphs.en: Fault injection [ 1 ] is increasingly used to evaluate the reliability of tool-using LLM agents. These agents interact with software systems through APIs that read and modify persistent state [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] , making controlled faults at tool interactions a natural way to study how erroneous information propagates through an execution. Existing evaluations report outcomes such as task degradation, recovery, and the propagation of faulty information into later actions or responses [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 故障注入 [ 1 ] 正被越来越多地用于评估使用工具的大型语言模型智能体的可靠性。 这些智能体通过读取和修改持久化状态的 API 与软件系统交互 [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] ，因此，在工具交互中引入受控故障是研究错误信息如何在执行过程中传播的自然方法。 现有的评估报告了诸如任务性能下降、恢复能力，以及错误信息向后续动作或响应中的传播等结果 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: While substantial effort has gone into constructing faults and studying their downstream effects, a basic question remains when interpreting the resulting adoption outcomes. A claim that an agent relied on an injected fault despite contradicting evidence requires more than fault propagation: valid counterevidence must have become visible before the agent first used the affected fact. Evaluating this condition poses two particular challenges for tool-using agents. First, the evaluator must determine what observation actually refutes the designated injected assertion. Second, because the agent selects subsequent tool interactions, the evaluator must distinguish whether such refutation is available through the interface from whether it becomes visible before use in the realized execution.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管在构建故障并研究其下游影响方面付出了巨大努力，但在解释由此产生的采用结果时，一个基本问题仍然存在。 要声称某个智能体依赖了注入的故障，尽管存在矛盾证据，这需要的不仅仅是故障传播：在智能体首次使用受影响的事实之前，有效的反证必须已经变得可见。 评估这一条件为使用工具的智能体带来了两个特定的挑战。 首先，评估者必须确定何种观察结果实际上能够推翻指定的注入断言。 其次，由于智能体选择后续的工具交互，评估者必须区分这种反驳是否可以通过接口获得，以及它是否在实现执行中于使用之前变得可见。

sents.zh: 首先，评估者必须确定何种观察结果实际上能够推翻指定的注入断言。

sents.en: Second, because the agent selects subsequent tool interactions, the evaluator must distinguish whether such refutation is available through the interface from whether it becomes visible before use in the realized execution.
sents.zh: 其次，由于智能体选择后续的工具交互，评估者必须区分这种反驳是否可以通过接口获得，以及它是否在实现执行中于使用之前变得可见。

paragraphs.en: The first issue concerns the specification of counterevidence. Retrieving information related to an affected fact does not necessarily establish a refutation of the injected assertion. For example, in our ItemOption operator, an authoritative product record lists valid product variants, but it refutes the corrupted option of a particular order item only after the visible execution establishes which product variant corresponds to that item. Treating every relevant read as counterevidence can therefore assign an evidential condition that the execution has not yet established.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个问题涉及反证据的规范。 检索与受影响事实相关的信息，并不必然构成对插入断言的反驳。 例如，在我们的 ItemOption 算子中，一个权威的产品记录会列出有效的产品变体，但只有在可见的执行过程确定了哪个产品变体对应于该订单项之后，它才会反驳某个特定订单项的损坏选项。 因此，将每一次相关的读取都视为反证据，可能会附加一个执行尚未满足的证据条件。

paragraphs.en: A second issue arises from the observation path taken during execution. The evaluation interface may provide a normal interaction through which an injected assertion can be checked, but the agent determines whether and when that interaction occurs. Consider a reservation update that is suppressed while the tool still returns status: success . An authoritative read-back of the unchanged reservation can refute this acknowledgement. One execution may perform that read before relying on the reported success, another may perform it only afterward, and another may never perform it. Thus, the opportunity to refute a fault and the evidential condition realized by an execution are different properties.
paragraphs.zh: 执行过程中所采用的观察路径引发了第二个问题。 评估界面可能提供一个正常的交互方式，通过该方式可以验证注入的断言，但智能体决定这种交互是否发生以及何时发生。 假设有一个预订更新操作被抑制了，而工具仍然返回状态：成功。 对未变更的预订进行权威性的回读，可以反驳这一确认信息。 一次执行可能在依赖报告的成功之前进行这种回读，另一次可能仅在之后进行，还有一次可能永远不进行。 因此，反驳故障的机会与执行所实现的证据条件是两个不同的属性。

paragraphs.en: Another issue concerns how an adoption outcome is interpreted [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] . Aggregate adoption establishes that an injected assertion propagated into faulty reliance, but it does not by itself establish that this happened after timely counterevidence. Likewise, eventual counterevidence combines executions in which the evidence arrived before use with executions in which it arrived only afterward. A claim about reliance despite timely counterevidence therefore requires a different observed population from a claim about fault propagation alone. We refer to this requirement as the evidential validity of a fault-injection claim.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个问题涉及如何解释采用结果 [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] 。 总体采用表明，注入的断言传播到了错误依赖中，但它本身并不能证明这种情况发生在及时的反证出现之后。 同样地，最终的反证将证据在使用前到达的执行与证据仅在使用后才到达的执行结合在了一起。 因此，关于在及时反证出现后仍存在依赖的主张，需要不同于仅关于错误传播主张的观察群体。 我们将这一要求称为故障注入主张的证据有效性。

An automated analysis may therefore recover a downstream fault signal while disagreeing with the semantic and temporal events required to interpret the fault-injection result.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we systematically study these issues in fault-injection evaluation of tool-using agents. We develop a measurement protocol that specifies the counterevidence for each injected assertion, establishes whether a legal continuation from the fixed faulted context can expose that counterevidence before the affected fact is first used, and reconstructs whether the evaluated execution actually realizes this condition. We construct SSCBench to instantiate the protocol on the retail and airline environments of τ \tau -bench [ 15 ] . SSCBench contains four fault operators spanning three counterevidence-acquisition structures. Our experiments cover five agent configurations and 1,191 faulted executions. We study how the realized evidential condition varies across executions, how it changes the empirical support behind adoption outcomes, how first faulty reliance relates to the primary use anchor, and how accurately automated trajectory analyses recover the required measurement events.

sents.zh: 我们研究了已实现的证据条件在不同执行中的变化方式、它如何改变采纳结果背后的经验支持、首次错误依赖与主要使用锚点之间的关系，以及自动化轨迹分析在多大程度上能够准确恢复所需的测量事件。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify and formalize an evidential-validity condition in fault-injection evaluation of tool-using agents. Interpreting adoption as faulty reliance under timely counterevidence requires both a valid refuting observation for the injected assertion and evidence that this observation became visible before the affected fact was first used.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别并形式化了工具使用智能体在故障注入评估中的证据有效性条件。 将采用行为解释为在及时出现反证情况下的错误依赖，既需要针对所注入断言的有效反驳观察，也需要有证据表明该观察在受影响的事实首次被使用前就已显现。

sents.en: We identify and formalize an evidential-validity condition in fault-injection evaluation of tool-using agents.
sents.zh: 我们识别并形式化了工具使用智能体在故障注入评估中的证据有效性条件。

paragraphs.en: We develop a measurement protocol and construct SSCBench to operationalize this condition. The protocol combines fault-specific counterevidence, case-level pre-use revealability, and execution-level reconstruction of counterevidence arrival and dependent use across four fault operators and three acquisition structures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们制定了一种测量协议，并构建了 SSCBench，以将这一条件具体化。 该协议结合了针对特定故障的反证、案例层面的使用前可揭示性，以及在四种故障操作符和三种获取结构中，对反证到达及其依赖使用的执行层面重构。

paragraphs.en: We empirically demonstrate that these measurement distinctions materially affect fault-injection evaluation across five agent configurations and 1,191 faulted executions. Admitted cases do not fix the evidential condition realized by an execution, aggregate outcomes can differ from the population supporting a claim-specific interpretation, and generic trajectory diagnostics can mismatch the semantic and temporal events needed for measurement. We derive practical guidelines for reporting and interpreting fault-injection results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过实证表明，这些测量差异对五种智能体配置和 1,191 次故障执行中的故障注入评估产生了实质性影响。 已受理的案例并未修正一次执行所实现的证据条件，汇总结果可能与支持特定主张解释的总体数据存在差异，且通用的轨迹诊断可能与测量所需的语义和时间事件不匹配。 我们制定了报告和解读故障注入结果的实用指南。

paragraphs.en: Fault injection evaluates how an agent behaves when a controlled error is introduced during its interaction with the environment [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 16 , 17 ] . A typical evaluation selects a task and agent configuration [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] , applies an intervention at an eligible tool interaction [ 23 ] , records the resulting trajectory [ 24 ] , and derives a downstream outcome such as task success, recovery, or propagation of faulty information into a later action or response [ 10 , 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 故障注入用于评估智能体在与环境交互过程中引入受控错误时的行为表现 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 16 , 17 ] 。 典型的评估流程会选择一个任务与智能体配置 [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] ，在某个符合条件的工具交互环节实施干预 [ 23 ] ，记录由此产生的轨迹 [ 24 ] ，并推导出后续结果，例如任务成功、恢复，或错误信息向后续动作或响应的传播 [ 10 , 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: For tool-using agents, the trajectory also determines what information becomes available after the intervention. Subsequent tool calls may expose authoritative state that contradicts the injected error, expose it only after the error has already influenced the execution, or never expose it at all. Thus, two executions can contain the same injected fault and the same downstream outcome while differing in the information available when that outcome is produced.
paragraphs.zh: 对于使用工具的智能体，执行轨迹也决定了干预之后哪些信息会变得可用。 后续的工具调用可能会揭示与注入错误相矛盾的权威状态，也可能在错误已经影响执行之后才揭示该状态，甚至可能完全无法揭示。 因此，两次执行可能包含相同的注入故障和相同的下游结果，但在产生该结果时可获得的信息却有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Consider the airline task in Figure 1 , adapted from τ \tau -bench [ 15 ] . The user asks the agent to change an existing reservation. We inject a WriteEffect fault that suppresses the requested update while preserving the tool’s successful acknowledgement. The tool returns status: success , although the stored reservation remains unchanged. A later get_reservation_details call can expose the unchanged reservation and contradict the reported success. Figure 1 b shows two executions of this same fault. In Run A, the agent tells the user that the flight was changed and reads the unchanged reservation only afterward. In Run B, the unchanged reservation becomes visible before the same claim is made. Both executions produce the same faulty downstream claim, but they are under different evidential conditions. In the figure, T E T_{E} marks the arrival of the contradicting observation and T S T_{S} marks the first use of the affected information.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑图 1 中的航空公司任务，该任务改编自 τ \tau -bench [ 15 ]。 用户要求智能体更改一个现有的预订。 我们注入一个 WriteEffect 故障，该故障会抑制所请求的更新，同时保留工具成功确认的表象。 工具返回状态为“成功”，尽管存储的预订仍然没有变化。 后续的一次 get_reservation_details 调用可能会暴露未更改的预订，从而与报告的成功状态相矛盾。 图 1b 展示了同一故障的两次执行过程。 在运行 A 中，智能体告诉用户航班已更改，但只是在之后才读取了未更改的预订信息。 在运行 B 中，未更改的预订信息在提出相同声明之前就已显现。 两次执行都产生了相同的错误下游结论，但它们所处的证据条件不同。 在图中，T E T_{E} 标记了矛盾观察结果的出现时间，而 T S T_{S} 标记了受影响信息的首次使用时刻。

paragraphs.en: The example exposes two distinctions that are important for fault-injection evaluation. First, information related to a fault is not necessarily sufficient to refute it. For example, in an item-option error, a product record becomes refuting evidence only after the execution establishes that the record corresponds to the affected order item. Second, the availability of a refuting observation through the interface does not determine whether a particular execution obtains it before the faulty information is used. The agent’s subsequent interactions determine that realization. These distinctions affect how a downstream adoption outcome can be interpreted. Observing that an injected error propagated into an agent action or response establishes fault propagation. Interpreting the same outcome as reliance despite timely counterevidence additionally requires evidence that the relevant refutation had become visible before use.
paragraphs.zh: 这个例子揭示了两个对于故障注入评估而言重要的区别。 首先，与故障相关的信息并不一定足以推翻该故障。 例如，在商品选项错误中，只有当执行过程确认该记录对应受影响的订单项之后，商品记录才会成为反驳证据。 其次，通过接口能否获得反驳性观察结果，并不能决定某次特定的执行是否在使用故障信息之前就已获取该结果。 智能体随后的交互决定了这一结果的实现。 这些区别会影响对下游采用结果的解读方式。 观察到注入的错误传播到了智能体的动作或响应中，即确立了故障的传播。 若要将相同的结果解释为依赖行为，尽管存在及时的反驳证据，则还需要有证据表明相关的反驳信息在使用前已经可见。

paragraphs.en: Definition 3.1 (Injected fault). An injected fault is an intervention at a tool interaction that causes the interaction to convey a faulty assertion v ′ v^{\prime} about an affected fact f f , while the authoritative environment state supports a different assertion v v . The observation carrying v ′ v^{\prime} is the fault-bearing observation . The affected fact is scoped to a target entity, attribute, and relevant state. For a state-changing operation, it may instead concern the claimed effect of a designated logical request. A run is triggered when the intervention takes effect and the fault-bearing observation is delivered to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 定义 3.1（注入故障）。 注入故障是指在工具交互过程中的一种干预，导致该交互传递了一个关于受影响事实 f 的错误断言 v ′ v^{\prime}，而权威环境状态则支持一个不同的断言 v。 携带 v ′ v^{\prime} 的观察即为承载故障的观察。 受影响的事实范围限定于目标实体、属性及相关状态。 对于状态变更操作，其影响可能转而涉及指定逻辑请求所声称的效果。 当干预生效且承载故障的观察被传递至智能体时，一个运行即被触发。

paragraphs.en: Definition 3.2 (Dependent use). A dependent use of f f is an agent message, tool call, or handoff whose observable content or arguments depend on a value or proposition about f f , including a derived value. Correct, qualified, and faulty uses all count. A call that only retrieves information about f f is not a dependent use unless its arguments themselves depend on f f .
paragraphs.zh: 定义 3.2（依赖使用）。 f 的依赖使用是指一条智能体消息、工具调用或交接，其可观察内容或参数依赖于关于 f 的值或命题，包括派生值。 正确、合格和有缺陷的使用都算在内。 一个仅获取有关 f 信息的调用不属于依赖使用，除非其参数本身依赖于 f。

paragraphs.en: Definition 3.3 (Faulty reliance and adoption.) A faulty reliance is a dependent use that treats v ′ v^{\prime} , or a value derived from it, as the operative task fact. A run adopts the fault, written A = 1 A=1 , if it contains at least one faulty reliance. Using a disputed value only to verify that value does not constitute faulty reliance.
paragraphs.zh: 定义 3.3（错误依赖与采用。）错误依赖是指一种依赖性的使用方式，它将 v ′ v^{\prime} 或由此派生出的值视为有效的任务事实。 如果一次运行至少包含一个错误依赖，则称该运行采用了这一错误，记作 A = 1 A=1 。 仅将争议值用于验证该值本身并不构成错误依赖。

paragraphs.en: Definition 3.4 (Valid counterevidence.) An observation, or set of observations, is valid counterevidence to v ′ v^{\prime} if all of the following conditions hold.
paragraphs.zh: 定义 3.4（有效的反证据。）一个观察结果，或一组观察结果，是 v ′ v^{\prime} 的有效反证据，当且仅当以下所有条件均成立。

paragraphs.en: Authority : its source is at least as authoritative for f f as the fault-bearing observation.
paragraphs.zh: 权威性：其来源对于 f f 而言至少与存在故障的观察结果同样具有权威性。

paragraphs.en: Entity : it concerns the same target entity.
paragraphs.zh: 实体：它涉及同一个目标实体。

paragraphs.en: Scope : it concerns the state or logical request named by the faulty assertion.
paragraphs.zh: 范围：它涉及由错误断言所命名的状态或逻辑请求。

paragraphs.en: Independence : it is grounded in information that the intervention did not alter to agree with v ′ v^{\prime} .
paragraphs.zh: 独立性：它基于这样的信息，即干预并未改变以符合 v ′ v^{\prime}。

paragraphs.en: Sufficiency : together with task and tool semantics already available to the agent, it is sufficient to contradict v ′ v^{\prime} .
paragraphs.zh: 充分性：结合智能体已具备的任务和工具语义，这足以反驳 v ′ v^{\prime}。

paragraphs.en: Evaluator-only knowledge does not contribute to sufficiency. Independence concerns the information source rather than the message boundary; valid counterevidence may therefore be co-delivered with the fault-bearing observation. paragraphs.en: SSCBench is a fault-injection benchmark in which every admitted case carries an explicit relation among a faulty assertion, the observations that can refute it, and the execution events that determine when those observations become model-visible. Figure 2 summarizes its three mechanisms. A fault contract binds an intervention to the affected fact and its valid counterevidence. Revealability admission establishes a legal continuation through which that counterevidence can arrive before the first dependent use. During evaluation, execution reconstruction recovers the realized fault, evidence, and use events from the trajectory. These mechanisms make counterevidence arrival both a controlled property of benchmark construction and an observable property of execution.
paragraphs.zh: SSCBench 是一个故障注入基准测试，其中每个被接受的案例都明确关联了有缺陷的断言、能够推翻该断言的观察结果，以及决定这些观察结果何时对模型可见的执行事件。 图 2 总结了其三种机制。 故障契约将干预措施与受影响的事实及其有效的反证绑定在一起。 可揭示性接受机制确立了一条合法的路径，使得该反证能够在首次依赖使用之前到达。 在评估过程中，执行重建会从轨迹中恢复已实现的故障、证据和使用事件。 这些机制使反证的到达既成为基准测试构建的一个受控属性，也成为执行过程中的一个可观察属性。

WriteEffect instead intervenes on a state transition and suppresses a matched update while preserving the successful acknowledgement returned by the tool. Each instantiation binds the intervention to a target entity, a concrete affected fact, and the authoritative observations that can contradict the resulting faulty assertion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从任务义务和工具合同中推导出算子模板，并将其实例化到具体的环境记录上。 三个读取值算子会修改返回观察结果中的一个指定字段，同时保持相应的权威记录不变。 WriteEffect 则介入状态转换，抑制匹配的更新，同时保留工具返回的成功确认信息。 每次实例化都将干预绑定到一个目标实体、一个具体的受影响事实，以及可能与此错误断言相矛盾的权威观察结果。

paragraphs.en: The four operators differ in their injected faults, the relations that make counterevidence sufficient, and the routes by which it can become model-visible. ReturnDate moves a reservation return date earlier, PaySource flips a payment category, and ItemOption substitutes an alternative option for an ordered item.
paragraphs.zh: 这四种操作符在它们注入的故障、使反证充分的关联，以及反证变得模型可见的路径方面各不相同。 ReturnDate 会将预订的返回日期提前，PaySource 会翻转支付类别，而 ItemOption 则会为已订购的商品替换为替代选项。

paragraphs.en: The operators instantiate three counterevidence-acquisition structures. For ReturnDate and PaySource , the observations required for refutation are co-delivered with the fault-bearing observation. Their sufficiency nevertheless depends on agent-visible semantics that connect the retained field to the affected fact. For ReturnDate , the retained outbound leg becomes counterevidence through the ordering constraint of a round trip. For PaySource , the retained payment identifier becomes sufficient only when its relation to the payment category is established to the agent; an empirical naming pattern in stored data alone does not supply this semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 操作者实例化了三个反证获取结构。 对于 ReturnDate 和 PaySource，用于反驳的观察结果会与承载故障的观察结果一同提供。 然而，它们的充分性取决于智能体可见的语义，这种语义将保留字段与受影响的事实连接起来。 对于 ReturnDate，通过往返行程的顺序约束，保留的出站行程段成为反证。 对于 PaySource，只有当智能体确认了保留的支付标识符与支付类别之间的关系时，它才变得充分；仅凭存储数据中的经验命名模式无法提供这种语义。

paragraphs.en: ItemOption instead uses a cross-record refutation relation. The authoritative product record identifies the valid variants, but it becomes counterevidence for a particular corrupted order item only after the product variant is bound to that item. The required product record may already be present in the visible prefix or may enter the execution through a later lookup. Counterevidence availability and counterevidence arrival can therefore differ across executions of the same instantiated fault.
paragraphs.zh: ItemOption 则使用一种跨记录的反证关系。 权威的产品记录会识别出有效的变体，但只有在产品变体与该订单项绑定之后，它才会成为某个特定错误订单项的反证。 所需的产品记录可能已经存在于可见前缀中，也可能通过后续查找进入执行流程。 因此，在不同执行同一实例化故障时，反证的可用性与反证的到达时间可能存在差异。

paragraphs.en: WriteEffect moves the refutation relation across a state transition. Its faulty assertion is carried by a successful acknowledgement whose tool contract states that the requested update has been committed. The mutation suppresses the designated state change while preserving that acknowledgement and the interface’s normal validation. Counterevidence is then provided by an authoritative read of the persistent reservation state after the attempt. The read refutes the acknowledgement only while it remains attributable to the same logical request.
paragraphs.zh: WriteEffect 将反驳关系转移到一个状态转换中。 其错误的断言由一个成功的确认所承载，而该确认的工具合同声明所请求的更新已被提交。 这种突变抑制了指定的状态变化，同时保留了该确认以及接口的正常验证。 随后，通过在尝试后对持久性保留状态进行权威读取来提供反证。 该读取仅在确认仍可归因于同一逻辑请求时才会反驳该确认。

sents.zh: 该读取仅在确认仍可归因于同一逻辑请求时才会反驳该确认。

paragraphs.en: To preserve this attribution, WriteEffect matches the target request by reservation, flight changes, cabin, and payment method. Repeated attempts belong to the same logical request only when no intervening write changes the affected field. A later reservation read therefore supplies counterevidence only when its state scope still refers to the suppressed attempt.
paragraphs.zh: 为保留此归因，WriteEffect 会根据预订、航班变更、客舱和支付方式来匹配目标请求。 只有当中间没有任何写入操作更改受影响的字段时，重复尝试才属于同一个逻辑请求。 因此，只有当后续预订读取的状态范围仍然指向被抑制的尝试时，它才会提供反证。

paragraphs.en: These acquisition structures constrain how valid counterevidence can enter an execution without fixing whether or when it actually does so. The resulting fault contract defines the semantic relation required for measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 这些获取结构限制了有效反证在进入执行时的方式，却无法确定它是否或何时真正进入。 由此产生的故障契约定义了测量所需的语义关系。

paragraphs.en: A fault contract determines what constitutes valid counterevidence. Admission additionally requires the normal interaction surface to permit that evidence to become model-visible before dependent use. SSCBench therefore admits a concrete injection context only when it has a pre-use revealability witness.
paragraphs.zh: 故障合同决定了什么构成有效的反证。 此外，接纳还要求正常的交互表面允许该证据在依赖使用之前变为模型可见的。 因此，SSCBench 仅在存在使用前的可揭示性证明时，才会接纳具体的注入上下文。

paragraphs.en: An admissible witness presupposes a valid fault contract. The designated intervention must preserve the operator’s non-target semantics, including schema and identifier constraints, while the affected fact remains relevant to the task. Evidence authority and sufficiency are grounded in domain and interface semantics available to the agent rather than in empirical correlations observed by the evaluator. For example, equality between an order price and a current catalog price does not establish a semantic requirement that the two values agree.
paragraphs.zh: 可接受的证据预设了一个有效的故障合同。 指定的干预措施必须保留操作员的非目标语义，包括模式和标识符约束，同时受影响的实体仍需与任务相关。 证据的权威性和充分性基于智能体可用的领域和接口语义，而非评估者观察到的经验相关性。 例如，订单价格与当前目录价格之间的相等关系，并不能确立这两个值必须一致的语义要求。

sents.zh: 可接受的证据预设了一个有效的故障合同。

paragraphs.en: The witness trace must establish the complete relation represented by the admission condition. The trace records the intervention and fault delivery, the provenance of lookup arguments, the observations that form counterevidence, and the proposed first dependent use. The evidence must satisfy authority, entity, scope, independence, and agent-visible sufficiency, with no earlier dependent use in the visible prefix. We retain the trace together with the prefix identifier and hash and the witness continuation, so the admission relation remains tied to the concrete injection context rather than inferred from the operator alone.
paragraphs.zh: 证人轨迹必须确立接纳条件所表示的完整关系。 该轨迹记录了干预与故障传递、查找论据的来源、构成反证的观察结果，以及提议的首个依赖使用。 证据必须满足权威性、实体性、范围性、独立性和智能体可见的充分性要求，且在前缀可见部分中不得存在更早的依赖使用。 我们将轨迹与前缀标识符和哈希值以及证人延续部分一并保留，这样接纳关系就能与具体的注入上下文保持关联，而非仅通过算子推断得出。

paragraphs.en: Revealability is context-specific. A witness can transfer to another visible prefix only when the identifiers, permissions, and refutation relation on which it depends remain valid; otherwise the new context requires its own witness. Conversely, absence of a qualifying witness leaves a candidate unresolved rather than establishing unrevealability. A candidate is admitted only when both its fault contract and a witness for the applicable injection context satisfy these conditions. Study inclusion thus operates at the case level: only candidates with a valid fault contract and applicable pre-use witness contribute executions to the primary analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 可揭示性具有上下文特定性。 只有当见证所依赖的标识符、权限和反驳关系仍然有效时，该见证才能转移到另一个可见前缀；否则，新上下文需要其自身的见证。 反之，缺乏符合条件的见证会使候选项处于未解决状态，而非确立不可揭示性。 只有当其故障合同以及适用于该注入上下文的见证同时满足这些条件时，候选项才会被接纳。 因此，研究纳入是在案例层面进行的：只有具备有效故障合同和适用预使用见证的候选项，才会为主要分析贡献执行过程。

paragraphs.en: SSCBench recovers T E T_{E} by applying the case contract to the delivered history. A tool name, database value, or evaluator-visible discrepancy alone is insufficient. paragraphs.en: To recover agent-side use events, SSCBench separates candidate extraction from semantic classification. An extraction pass identifies post-fault references to the affected entity and value, including derived values, without providing the mutation’s correctness label. Each candidate event is then interpreted under the fault contract to determine semantic dependence and faulty reliance. A search argument derived from the faulty value, for example, is a dependent use, but it becomes a faulty reliance only when the surrounding visible context treats that value as an operative task fact rather than as a value being checked or enumerated. The first determinate dependent use defines T S T_{S} ; in an adopting run, the first determinate faulty reliance defines T U T_{U} . A textual qualification does not cancel an action that operationally commits to the faulty assertion.
paragraphs.zh: 为了恢复智能体侧的使用事件，SSCBench 将候选项提取与语义分类分离。 一个提取步骤会识别故障后对受影响实体和值的引用（包括派生值），但不会提供该突变的正确性标签。 随后，每个候选事件都会根据故障合同进行解释，以确定其语义依赖性和故障依赖性。 例如，从故障值中推导出的搜索论证属于一种依赖使用，但只有当周围的可见上下文将该值视为一个有效的任务事实，而非被检查或枚举的值时，它才会成为故障依赖性。 第一个确定的依赖使用定义了 T S T_{S}；在采用运行中，第一个确定的故障依赖性定义了 T U T_{U}。 文本上的限定并不会取消某个在操作层面已对故障断言做出承诺的动作。

paragraphs.en: SSCBench treats decidability as part of the measurement record. A complete trace with no dependent use is labeled no-use ; a potentially earlier but unresolved use instead leaves T S T_{S} undecidable. Likewise, one certain faulty reliance establishes adoption even when an earlier ambiguous event leaves T U T_{U} unknown, whereas the absence of a certain faulty reliance does not establish non-adoption while a potential use remains unresolved. For adopted runs, SSCBench records the last determinate, unreplaced explicit stance toward the faulty assertion; an erroneous action without a communicated stance leaves it undecidable. The resulting record stores both the value and the decidability of T E T_{E} , T S T_{S} , T U T_{U} , adoption, arrival stratum, and terminal stance.
paragraphs.zh: SSCBench 将可判定性视为测量记录的一部分。 没有依赖使用的完整轨迹会被标记为“无使用”；而一个可能更早但尚未解决的使用则会使 T S T_{S} 保持不可判定。 同样，一旦存在某种确定的错误依赖，即使更早的模糊事件使 T U T_{U} 处于未知状态，也会确立采用；而如果没有确定的错误依赖，则无法确立未采用，只要潜在使用尚未解决。 对于被采用的运行，SSCBench 会记录针对该错误断言的最后确定且未被替换的明确立场；如果错误操作没有传达任何立场，则其判定性保持未知。 最终记录将存储 T E T_{E}、T S T_{S}、T U T_{U} 的值和可判定性，以及采用状态、到达层级和最终立场。

paragraphs.en: Study Subjects and Sampling. We use the retail and airline environments of τ \tau -bench. ItemOption targets retail order items, while ReturnDate , PaySource , and WriteEffect target airline reservations. Candidate frames are constructed from task specifications and environment records before evaluated-agent runs. They contain 105 ReturnDate , 203 ItemOption , 120 PaySource , and 174 WriteEffect candidates. For each operator, we fix a candidate order using stable identifiers and screen candidates until 30 cases satisfy fault validity and pre-use revealability. Sampling cycles through target-entity clusters and does not use outcomes from the evaluated agents. Entity clusters are reservations for ReturnDate and WriteEffect , order items for ItemOption , and users for PaySource . The final study contains 120 admitted seeds, 30 per operator. Specifically, the ItemOption sample contains 30 items from 15 orders and 14 tasks. 16 initially selected candidates were replaced after the final semantic review using the same frozen candidate order, completing the 30-seed sample by rank 84. Ten admitted cases are target-value controls. They are retained in the arrival analysis and excluded from the primary adoption and diagnosis analyses.

paragraphs.en: We report 95% intervals using Wilson intervals when each contributing entity cluster provides one evaluable run and cluster bootstrap intervals otherwise ( B = 2,000 B=2{,}000 ). Sensitivity analyses use common clean-solved seeds, all available repetitions, a stricter ItemOption admission rule, and the inclusion of target-value controls. For repeated configurations, we also record whether a seed–configuration pair changes arrival condition across repetitions. We additionally re-express the same WriteEffect r0 runs as adoption, adoption with eventual counterevidence, and adoption with pre-use counterevidence. Two paired checks modify either the contradiction relation ( ItemOption and WriteEffect , F/V) or the reservation read-back cue ( WriteEffect , F/V/L/S). Arrival-stratified comparisons are descriptive rather than causal.
paragraphs.zh: 当每个贡献实体簇提供一个可评估的运行实例时，我们使用威尔逊区间报告 95% 置信区间；否则则使用簇自助法区间（B = 2,000 B=2{,}000）。 敏感性分析采用通用的干净求解种子、所有可用重复试验、更严格的 ItemOption 准入规则，以及目标值控制项的纳入。 对于重复配置，我们还记录种子-配置对在不同重复试验中是否改变了到达条件。 此外，我们将相同的 WriteEffect r0 运行重新表示为采用、最终出现反证时的采用，以及使用前出现反证时的采用。 两项配对检查分别修改矛盾关系（ItemOption 和 WriteEffect，F/V）或保留回读提示（WriteEffect，F/V/L/S）。 按到达分层进行的比较属于描述性分析，而非因果性分析。

paragraphs.en: Human Measurement Validation. Reviewers A, B, and C independently perform the human review, and reviewer D adjudicates disagreements. At case level, reviewers assess task relevance, evidence authority, agent-visible sufficiency, and entity or request scope without access to evaluated-agent outcomes. For execution-level validation, A, B, and C first complete five calibration trajectories and then independently review 120 faulted trajectories sampled across operators, configurations, and automatic arrival conditions. They label T E T_{E} , T S T_{S} , T U T_{U} , A A , and quantity-specific decidability from the fault contract and numbered model-visible trajectory. Configuration identity, experimental condition, automatic labels, and automatic event locations are masked. Z S Z_{S} is derived from the reviewed T E T_{E} and T S T_{S} . A label is accepted directly only when A, B, and C agree. Any disagreement is adjudicated by D; a 2–1 majority is not automatically accepted. We report pre-adjudication Fleiss’ κ \kappa for categorical quantities and exact-step agreement when all three reviewers locate the event. Automatic measurements are compared with the adjudicated reference on event status, exact event location when both sources locate the event, Z S Z_{S} , and A A .

paragraphs.en: Automated Oracle Evaluation. The oracle reference set contains the 120 adjudicated faulted trajectories and 40 clean trajectories, ten per operator, as negative controls. Adoption evaluation uses faulted trajectories with decidable human A A ; localization uses adopted faulted trajectories with decidable human T U T_{U} . We report adoption precision, recall, and F1, together with false-positive rates on clean and non-adopting faulted runs. Coverage is reported separately. Adoption recall uses the full applicable reference set, so abstentions count as missed positives. Localization is measured by exact and ± 1 \pm 1 -step accuracy over the full applicable adopted set, with abstentions counted as nonmatches. Results are also stratified by operator and human arrival condition. Table II summarizes the evaluated settings. L0 contains the numbered trajectory, tool schema, and domain policy; L1 additionally provides the fault-specific relation contract; L-DB contains invariants mined from clean database states. LLM-based settings use one call per trajectory and setting. B3-native is evaluated on the 40 ItemOption faulted trajectories for which the native AgentRx setting was run with one-shot; B3-SAA uses the full faulted reference set. For B1 and B5, an emitted anomaly or invariant violation is treated as a positive verdict. B4 produces only a step and is excluded from adoption metrics.

paragraphs.en: For the co-delivered operators, every evaluable run was pre-arrival: adoption was 100% for ReturnDate (149/149) and 59% for PaySource (89/150). For ItemOption , 47/58 evaluable non-control runs adopted the fault, including 15/25 pre-arrival and 32/33 late-arrival runs. Of these, 44 eventually received counterevidence, but only 17 received it before first use; 27 received it afterward and 57 received none in the observed execution. paragraphs.en: Measure Evidential Conditions per Execution. Case admission establishes that a timely refutation is possible under the fixed fault context; it does not assign an evidential condition to subsequent executions. That condition depends on the observation path realized before the affected fact is used. Consequently, revealability should remain a case-level qualification, while arrival should be reconstructed from each evaluated trajectory. This separation also clarifies absent arrival. For an admitted case, absence means that valid counterevidence did not become model-visible in the observed execution; it does not mean that the interface lacked a legal pre-use refutation route. Assigning the case-level witness to every run would therefore erase execution-dependent variation that is part of the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 按每次执行测量证据条件。 案例接纳确立了在固定故障情境下能够及时反驳；但它并未为后续执行分配任何证据条件。 该条件取决于在受影响事实被使用之前所实现的观察路径。 因此，可揭示性应保留为案例级别的资格，而抵达性则应从每条评估轨迹中重新构建。 这种分离也阐明了未发生抵达的情况。 对于一个已被接纳的案例而言，“缺席”意味着有效的反证在已观察的执行过程中并未成为模型可见的内容；它并不意味着接口缺乏合法的使用前反驳路径。 因此，若将案例级别的见证分配给每次运行，就会抹除属于评估部分的、依赖于执行的变异性。

paragraphs.en: Bind Claims to Their Evidential Denominators. Fault propagation, adoption with eventual counterevidence, and adoption under timely counterevidence require different observed conditions. An aggregate adoption rate therefore supports a propagation claim over its own evaluable population; it does not inherit support for a stronger claim whose required evidential condition is absent from those executions. Evaluation reports should make this claim–population relation explicit. When a claim refers to timely counterevidence, its evaluable pre-arrival population is part of the result. An empty stratum leaves that claim unobserved, while a small stratum limits the precision with which it can be characterized, regardless of how well determined the aggregate adoption rate is.
paragraphs.zh: 将主张与其证据性指标相关联。 故障传播、最终出现反证时的采纳，以及在及时出现反证时的采纳，需要不同的观察条件。 因此，综合采纳率支持某一主张在其自身可评估群体中的成立；但它并不继承对更强主张的支持，因为该主张所需的证据条件在这些执行中并不存在。 评估报告应明确说明这种主张与群体之间的关系。 当某项主张涉及及时出现的反证时，其可评估的到达前群体是结果的一部分。 空层会使该主张未被观察到，而小层则会限制对其特征描述的精确度，无论综合采纳率被确定得多么准确。

T S T_{S} provides an adoption-independent anchor for the evidential condition, whereas T U T_{U} localizes the first faulty reliance in adopted runs. Y end Y_{\mathrm{end}} describes a later stance but provides no evidence that earlier external effects were repaired. Evaluations that study recovery should therefore state which of these stages their outcome represents.

paragraphs.en: Validate Automated Measurement Against the Target Construct. A trajectory-analysis method is not automatically a valid measurement oracle because it detects faults, anomalies, or critical steps. The oracle used by an evaluation must recover the semantic event named by the measurement construct and, when temporal interpretation is required, its location in the trajectory. Validation should therefore cover more than aggregate verdict accuracy. It should evaluate semantic classification, temporal localization, coverage or abstention, and error variation across the evidential conditions used in downstream analysis. Otherwise, oracle errors can change not only individual labels but also the measured composition of the populations used to support the evaluation claims.
paragraphs.zh: 验证自动化测量与目标构念的一致性。 轨迹分析方法并不自动成为有效的测量预言机，因为它仅能检测故障、异常或关键步骤。 评估所使用的预言机必须能够恢复测量构念所命名的语义事件，并在需要时间解释时，确定其在轨迹中的位置。 因此，验证不应仅限于总体判断的准确性。 它应评估语义分类、时间定位、覆盖范围或弃权情况，以及下游分析中使用的证据条件下误差的变化。 否则，预言机错误不仅可能改变单个标签，还可能改变用于支持评估主张的总体群体的测量构成。

paragraphs.en: Measurement validity. Case admission and event reconstruction involve semantic judgments about task relevance, valid counterevidence, dependent use, and faulty reliance. We mitigate this threat with frozen decision rules, independent review and adjudication, and validation of the automatic measurements against human-adjudicated trajectories. The stricter ItemOption admission analysis further shows how results change under a narrower interpretation of task relevance. Our conclusions therefore apply to the constructs and admission rules stated in this paper. Arrival and adoption are measured from the same realized trajectories. Arrival-conditioned comparisons are consequently descriptive rather than causal. Likewise, terminal stance measures later endorsement of the faulty assertion, not repair of an earlier external effect. The paired perturbations support the reported behavioral contrasts but do not isolate counterevidence arrival as a causal mediator.

paragraphs.en: External validity. Our experiments cover two τ \tau -bench domains, four fault operators, and five agent configurations. The operators instantiate three counterevidence- acquisition structures, but each operator realizes a particular task and interface semantics; other tool contracts or interaction patterns may yield different arrival distributions and use dynamics. The empirical rates should therefore be interpreted for the studied settings rather than as population estimates for tool-using agents in general. The measurement protocol itself applies to fault-injection settings in which the affected fact, a task-authoritative refutation, and their relation to downstream use can be specified from the execution interface. Settings without such a refutation relation fall outside the scope of the claims studied here.

paragraphs.en: Fault injection has increasingly been used to evaluate tool-using agents under unreliable software environments. AgentChaos injects faults at the LLM–API response boundary and studies their propagation through agent executions [ 6 ] . ToolBench-X evaluates recovery from hazards spanning tool specifications, invocations, execution, outputs, and cross-source conflicts [ 7 ] . ToolMaze and AgentNoiseBench likewise exercise agents under unreliable tool interactions [ 8 , 9 ] . AgentProp-Bench traces parameter errors and their downstream propagation through later actions and responses [ 11 ] . Together, these studies characterize how controlled perturbations affect task outcomes, agent actions, recovery, and the propagation of corrupted information.
paragraphs.zh: 故障注入技术被越来越多地用于评估在不可靠软件环境中使用工具的智能体。 AgentChaos 在 LLM–API 响应边界注入故障，并研究这些故障在智能体执行过程中的传播情况 [ 6 ] 。 ToolBench-X 评估了从工具规范、调用、执行、输出以及跨源冲突等层面出现的风险中恢复的能力 [ 7 ] 。 ToolMaze 和 AgentNoiseBench 同样在不可靠的工具交互环境中对智能体进行压力测试 [ 8 , 9 ] 。 AgentProp-Bench 追踪参数错误及其在后续动作和响应中的下游传播过程 [ 11 ] 。 综合来看，这些研究描述了受控扰动如何影响任务结果、智能体的行为、恢复能力以及受损信息的传播。

paragraphs.en: A related body of work examines how agents acquire and use unreliable or conflicting information. Yang et al. [ 10 ] study the delivery and adoption of corrupted tool outputs, while work on inconsistent tool responses and interactive knowledge conflicts examines agent behavior when competing information becomes available [ 28 , 29 ] . Roh et al. [ 30 ] distinguish failures that occur before evidence inspection from those that remain after a relevant read, and ToolFailBench separates skipped tool use from failures to use returned information [ 31 ] . ContainmentBench further analyzes propagation and recovery at different execution stages after prompt injection [ 32 ] . These studies show that fault propagation, evidence acquisition, evidence use, and downstream failure need not coincide within an execution.
paragraphs.zh: 相关研究探讨了智能体如何获取和使用不可靠或相互矛盾的信息。Yang 等人 [ 10 ] 研究了被篡改的工具输出结果的传递与采用，而关于工具响应不一致性和交互式知识冲突的研究则考察了当出现相互竞争的信息时智能体的行为 [ 28 , 29 ] 。Roh 等人 [ 30 ] 区分了发生在证据检查之前的故障与在相关读取之后仍存在的故障，并且 ToolFailBench 将跳过工具使用与未能使用返回信息的情况区分开来 [ 31 ] 。 ContainmentBench 进一步分析了提示注入后不同执行阶段中的传播与恢复情况 [ 32 ] 。 这些研究表明，故障传播、证据获取、证据使用以及下游故障并不一定在一次执行中同时发生。

paragraphs.en: Fault-based testability studies whether a fault can propagate to an observation that distinguishes faulty from correct behavior [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] . Classical work such as PIE characterizes the conditions required for a fault to become observable, and subsequent testing research further studies observability and test-oracle effectiveness [ 38 ] . These studies establish the role of distinguishing observations in fault revelation. For tool-using agents, we study a related evaluation problem in which the distinguishing observation is counterevidence to an injected assertion and its arrival depends on the agent’s subsequent tool interactions. Our measurement separates whether the fault propagates from whether adoption occurs after such counterevidence becomes visible before use.
paragraphs.zh: 故障导向可测试性研究旨在确定故障是否能够传播到某个能够区分故障行为与正确行为的观察点 [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] 。 经典研究（如 PIE）描述了故障变得可观测所需满足的条件，而后续测试研究则进一步探讨了可观测性和测试判据的有效性 [ 38 ] 。 这些研究确立了区分性观察在故障暴露过程中的作用。 对于使用工具的智能体，我们研究一个相关的评估问题：其中区分性观察是对所注入断言的反证，而该观察的出现取决于智能体后续与工具的交互。 我们的测量方法将故障是否传播与在使用前、反证显现后是否发生采用行为这两个问题区分开来。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we studied the evidential conditions under which fault-injection outcomes for tool-using agents can be interpreted. A fault case may provide a valid pre-use refutation opportunity without fixing the evidential condition realized by a particular execution, and an aggregate adoption result may therefore support a different claim from adoption observed under timely counterevidence. We introduced SSCBench to make these conditions explicit through fault contracts, pre-use revealability admission, and execution-level reconstruction. Our experiments show that realized counterevidence exposure can vary after the fault case and agent configuration are fixed, that claim-specific evidential populations can be sparse even when aggregate adoption is well defined, that first-error timing and later recovery describe different execution stages, and that generic trajectory diagnostics do not necessarily recover the semantic and temporal events required by the measurement. These findings motivate four practices for fault-injection evaluation: measure evidential conditions per execution, bind claims to their evaluable evidential populations, distinguish prevention, revision, and repair, and validate automated oracles against the constructs used by the evaluation. Our study covers four fault operators, five agent configurations, and 1,191 faulted executions. We hope these results support more precise and reproducible interpretation of fault-injection evaluations for tool-using agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了在哪些证据条件下，工具使用智能体的故障注入结果可以被解读。 一个故障案例可能提供一个有效的使用前反驳机会，而无需修正特定执行所实现的证据条件；因此，综合采用结果可能与在及时反证下观察到的采用结果支持不同的主张。 我们引入了 SSCBench，通过故障合同、使用前可揭示性声明以及执行层面的重构，使这些条件变得明确。 我们的实验表明：在故障案例和智能体配置固定后，已实现的反证暴露程度可能有所不同；即使综合采用结果定义明确，特定主张的证据群体也可能稀疏；首次错误发生时间与后续恢复描述了不同的执行阶段；而通用的轨迹诊断并不一定能还原测量所需的语义和时间事件。 这些发现为故障注入评估提出了四种实践方法：按每次执行测量证据条件、将主张与其可评估的证据群体绑定、区分预防、修正和修复，以及使用评估所用结构验证自动化预言机。 我们的研究涵盖了四种故障操作符、五种智能体配置以及 1,191 次存在故障的执行。 我们希望这些结果能够支持对工具使用智能体的故障注入评估进行更精确且可重复的解读。

sents.zh: 我们的研究涵盖了四种故障操作符、五种智能体配置以及 1,191 次存在故障的执行。

sents.en: We hope these results support more precise and reproducible interpretation of fault-injection evaluations for tool-using agents.
sents.zh: 我们希望这些结果能够支持对工具使用智能体的故障注入评估进行更精确且可重复的解读。
